info.title: AegisGate Local Management API
info.description: Foundation health defaults to loopback HTTP. Explicit module02 configuration enables loopback HTTPS management with OIDC, database membership authorization and CSRF. No serving proxy or config publication.

302.description: Redirect to configured OIDC authorization endpoint; sets Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax browser binding cookie

200.description: Authenticated; sets Secure session cookie and session-bound CSRF cookie
Process alive, not a readiness assertion

503.description: A bounded error with server-generated correlation UUID

Unavailable.description: A bounded error with server-generated correlation UUID
